title: Lamb Kebabs with Tzatziki Sauce
description: A classic Middle Eastern dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs served with a refreshing tzatziki sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine Greek yogurt, cucumber, and dill in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve tzatziki sauce alongside lamb kebabs.
Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges, if desired.
